entities.name: Jaxis
entities.description: A human boxer of the Riveteers in New Capenna known as the Troublemaker, undefeated and seen as blessed.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A New Capenna family with which Jaxis is affiliated.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: A New Capenna family that sent assassins against Jaxis.

events.summary: Assassins sent by the Maestros attack Jaxis; burning shadows of past champions appear and drive them off.
events.quote: Called forth by some unknown power, these champions fought alongside her, driving off the assassins

relations.note: She is affiliated with the Riveteers.
relations.quote: a human warrior affiliated with the Riveteers family in New Capenna

relations.note: Maestros assassins tried to eliminate her.
relations.quote: a group of assassins sent by the Maestros attempted to eliminate her
